answer.text:
If your budget is **strictly ₹3,000** and **hot-swappable switches are mandatory**, these are the ones I'd look at:

Redragon K617 Fizz$24.52 · Vishal PeripheralsAjazz AK873$30.99 · Walmart - LexonTechRedragon K677 Pro Rammus$45.00 · Best Buy

### 🏆 My pick: Kreo Hive 65

The **Kreo Hive 65** looks like the strongest overall choice around this budget. It has a **65% layout, 5-pin hot-swap sockets, gasket mounting, and pre-lubed linear switches**, giving you a much better starting point for customizing later. Recent Indian pricing has been around **₹2,599**.

### Other good options

- **EvoFox Katana S Mini — ~₹1,599:** Excellent if you want to spend as little as possible. 65%, hot-swappable, RGB and 1000 Hz polling.
- **Redragon K617 Fizz — ~₹2,200–₹2,500:** Great **60%** option, especially for FPS gaming. It has hot-swap support and linear red switches.
- **Cosmic Byte Firefly TKL — ~₹2,350–₹2,800:** Better if you want a **TKL layout with dedicated arrow keys and F-row** while retaining hot-swap.
- **Cosmic Byte Artemis — ~₹2,600:** Worth considering if **wireless + hot-swap** is important; it offers tri-mode connectivity and per-key RGB.

**My ranking:**

🥇 **Kreo Hive 65** — best overall

🥈 **Cosmic Byte Artemis** — best wireless

🥉 **EvoFox Katana S Mini** — best value

🎮 **Redragon K617 Fizz** — best for FPS/compact setup

⌨️ **Cosmic Byte Firefly TKL** — best if you want F-row + arrows

If you tell me whether you want **60%, 65%, 75%, or TKL**, and whether you prefer **red/brown/blue switches**, I can narrow it down to **one keyboard under ₹3,000**.
